chunks: Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام passed by a woman in ihram who had concealed herself with a fan, so he moved the fan away from her face with his staff.

key_terms.فَأَمَاطَ: so he moved away or removed
key_terms.مُحْرِمَةٍ: a woman in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: Can a woman in ihram cover her face with a fan?
ai.summary: This report describes Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام encountering a woman in the state of ihram who had covered her face with a fan, and removing it from her face with his staff. It indicates a practical example related to the rulings and limits of what is worn or used to cover the face during ihram.
